subject: Post-demo: traffic anchor, burst ops checklist & pricing brackets
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@pixelpay.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + one ask: monthly token anchor & peak TPS

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really enjoyed walking through the Hosted API flow and the live latency snapshots. Quick recap and one concrete request so we can produce an accurate cost estimate:

- Summary: PixelPay wants to use Redwood for fraud-detection enrichment + customer messaging. You run model calls on every transaction and also have batch enrichment windows.
- Next step for pricing: could you share an expected monthly token volume range (low / mid / high) and the peak TPS (or 99th-percentile TPS) you anticipate during your busiest windows?
- Helpful to know: average tokens per request (input+output) and whether the burst windows are sustained (>5 minutes) or short spikes (<1 minute).

Attached is a tiny CSV template (pixelpay_traffic_snapshot.csv) you can fill with the totals; if easier, a short reply with ranges works fine. Once we have that, Karthik will produce a quick published-cost + recommended configuration (batching, token compression, and suggested $/1M target bands).

Attachments: pixelpay_traffic_snapshot.csv (template)

Thanks — would like to have a draft estimate to share with your procurement by early next week.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Alex Chen <alex@pixelpay.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pixelpay.io>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + one ask: monthly token anchor & peak TPS

Hi Grace — really useful demo, thanks. See our initial numbers below (high level):

- Monthly token volume (expected): 8,000,000 — 12,000,000 tokens/month (we're targeting 10M as the working anchor).
- Average tokens per call: ~420 tokens (input ~120, output ~300) — variety depending on template.
- Peak TPS: sustained peak windows are around 35 TPS; short spikes up to ~65 TPS (99th percentile ~50 TPS).
- Burst windows: generally short (30s–90s) after promotional pushes, but we also have scheduled batch-enrichment windows overnight that are larger but flexible.
- Budget target: $700 — $900 per 1M tokens (we're trying to land somewhere ~ $800/1M if performance is solid).

Two quick questions: 1) What does Redwood recommend for short spike handling vs sustained batch windows? 2) Do you have a sample cost table we can attach to our internal SOW?

I'll try to upload a filled CSV later today.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, PixelPay
alex@pixelpay.io | +1 212-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@pixelpay.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + one ask: monthly token anchor & peak TPS

Alex — this is great context, thanks. A few quick clarifications and a suggested cost sketch: 

- Mapping tokens -> QPS: with ~420 tokens per call, 35 TPS translates to ~14.7k tokens/s peak sustained; short spikes to 65 TPS -> ~27.3k tokens/s.
- For short spikes (30s–90s): recommend keeping a small burst buffer (we can provision transient capacity) + autoscaling with fast warmup. This yields marginally higher unit cost during bursts but keeps latency SLOs.
- For overnight batch enrichment: use Dedicated batch workers (lower $/token via higher batching + KV-caching).

Preliminary published-cost sketch (illustrative):
- Option A (hosted, conservative configs): $880 / 1M tokens (includes burst buffer + 99.9th p99 path).
- Option B (hosted + caching tuned): $760 / 1M tokens (requires avg payload profiling and minimal prefix caching).

I'll attach a short PDF with the sketch (redwood_pricing_estimate_PIX-892.pdf) and a notes page on what inputs would move you between A/B (avg tokens reduced, more caching, batching window).

Can we schedule a 30-min procurement alignment next Tue to finalize bands and draft the SOW? Grace — happy to join the call.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_PIX-892.pdf (sketch)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
